verdict.rationale: Kitty documents remote control, so external scripts can drive it, and the runtime probe confirms a detached instance can be controlled by an external agent loop. That is a developer building block that relies on user-supplied scripts. It is not a first-party feature for creating automations that run autonomously or on a recurring schedule. Startup sessions are a one-off environment setup, not background automation, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
